# Bring the broken toaster. Stay for coffee.
## Our first Fix-It Saturday at St. Ansgar

**Saturday, December 5, 2026 · 9 a.m.–1 p.m.**  
**Fellowship Hall, St. Ansgar Lutheran Church · Minneapolis, MN**  
**Enter by the alley door, where there’s a ramp.**

A while back, Marv Okafor fixed my 1970s Hamilton Beach mixer in twenty minutes in the church kitchen. That’s where this idea began. Too much gets thrown away when all it needs is a screw, a new cord, or somebody who knows where to look.

Last week, our church council approved Fix-It Saturday, and I confess I’m thrilled.

Starting December 5, we’re opening the Fellowship Hall to the whole neighborhood for a morning of fixing things together. Our volunteer fixers can help with small appliances, lamps, bikes, clothing mending, and knife sharpening. We also have a retired tech guy ready to help with laptops and phones. We can’t promise every item can be repaired, but we’re glad to take a look.

Doris Lindqvist, 84, has been darning socks for this parish since the Carter years. She asked to run the mending table herself. I was not about to argue.

**It’s free. No church membership, no sign-up, no strings.** Nobody will preach at you. Donations to the food shelf are welcome, but not expected. This is good neighboring, plain and simple.

Please bring **one item per person to start**, so we can keep the line moving. There will be coffee and kringle, and we hope you’ll stay a while. Bring the broken toaster, yes—but leave yourself time for coffee with a neighbor, too.

After December, we’ll gather on the **first Saturday of every month through spring**.

**Could you join our crew of volunteer fixers?** We’d especially love to hear from anyone who can repair vacuums or replace zippers. Contact the church office at **office@stansgarlutheran.example** or **612-555-0148**.

Whether you’ve been coming to St. Ansgar for fifty years or have never been through the door, you’re welcome here.
